compatibility.source: Riot Vanguard requires a Windows kernel driver
notes: Riot Vanguard loads as a Windows kernel driver at boot. Wine implements Windows' user-space APIs, not its kernel, so there is nothing for the driver to load into.
This is not a bug EasyPlay can work around, and no future preset will change it.
Attempting to bypass anti-cheat can also get your account banned, so EasyPlay refuses to try.
